comparison.objective: Loosen a nut with an adjustable wrench after snugging its jaw, then remove and set down the wrench.
comparison.physical_skill: Adjust jaw play on flats, pull in the load-safe direction, and control breakaway torque without rounding the nut.
comparison.success_condition: Nut turns sufficiently counterclockwise without a loose-jaw or wrong-direction fault; wrench is removed, released, and set down.
comparison.reason: Jaw adjustment and torque-direction control are different from parallel rail–jig alignment and uncaged-block transfer. No missing rubric detail prevents distinction.
